title: Inverse-image structure map compatibility on stalks
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $x\in X$. For the inverse-image ring and canonical structure map $\alpha:f^{-1}\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-pc-module-pullback], there is a ring isomorphism $e:\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}\cong(f^{-1}\mathcal O_S)_x$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] such that $\alpha_x\circ e=f^\sharp_x$. No flatness or module hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0098 and 0095; inverse-image ring stalks and adjunction structure-map germ formula

proof.text: Use the natural commutative-ring inverse-image stalk isomorphism. Transport it to inverseImageConstruction using the unique comparison of the two left adjoints to the same sheaf pushforward. The adjunction unit compatibility gives its value on all germs.

Apply the stalk map of tensorPullbackRingMap to a germ. Naturality of germs and the adjunction hom-equivalence unit identity give the germ of f.c(s). The defining germ equation for f.stalkMap gives the same value. Stalk maps are determined by all germs, proving the required equality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_inverseImageStructure_stalk_iso
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (x : X) :
    ∃ e : S.presheaf.stalk (f x) ≅
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat.{u} x).obj
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base S.sheaf).obj,
      e.hom ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat.{u} x).map
        (Modules.tensorPullbackRingMap f).hom = f.stalkMap x
